mainEntity.name: Can functional medicine balance my hormones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We treat hormone symptoms by reading the whole system, thyroid, adrenal, and sex hormones, and addressing what is throwing it off, rather than adjusting one number. Most people feel mood, energy, and sleep improve as balance returns.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from standard hormone treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard care often adjusts a single hormone. As a functional medicine hormone doctor in Atlanta, Dr. Nina Ross maps how your hormones move together and builds a personalized plan to restore the whole system.

mainEntity.name: What testing do you run for hormones?

acceptedAnswer.text: We go beyond a basic panel, with full thyroid, adrenal and cortisol rhythm, and sex hormones, plus metabolic markers, so the plan targets your specific root causes.

mainEntity.name: My labs are normal but I feel awful. Why?

acceptedAnswer.text: Normal range flags disease, not how well you function. We read your hormones against optimal ranges and in relationship to one another, which is where the answer usually hides.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer bioidentical hormone therapy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Where it is appropriate, yes. We use hormone therapy as one tool inside a full plan, alongside nutrition and root-cause work, and always as your informed choice.

mainEntity.name: Is this just a normal part of aging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hormones do shift with age, but feeling unwell is not something you have to accept. We find what is driving the symptoms and support your body so you feel like yourself again.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer virtual hormone care or only in person in Atlanta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. See Dr. Nina Ross in person at our Atlanta clinic, or virtually anywhere in Georgia. Your $99 Symptom Consultation can be booked either way.

sections.label: Hero

headings.text: Root-cause hormone care in Atlanta that finally helps you feel balanced.

paragraphs: If the mood swings, the stalled weight, the low drive and the cycles that feel off have left you feeling like a stranger in your body, you are not imagining it.

These shifts are real, and they deserve someone who will listen to the whole story. At Nina Ross Functional Medicine, we treat hormones at their root, here in Atlanta and virtually across Georgia. Dr. Nina Ross follows the whole picture, thyroid, adrenals, and sex hormones, until she finds what is really throwing you off, then builds the plan around your body and your life.

sections.label: Why conventional care misses it

headings.text: You were told your numbers were in range.

eyebrowSpans: Why conventional care keeps missing it
paragraphs: A fifteen-minute visit rarely has room to read the whole hormonal system. So symptoms get treated one at a time, and the imbalance connecting them goes unexamined.

boldPairs.title: What you’re usually told
boldPairs.body: “Your hormones are in the normal range. This is just part of getting older.”

boldPairs.title: What’s actually happening
boldPairs.body: Thyroid, adrenals, and sex hormones are pulling each other off balance in a loop. Restore the loop and the symptoms settle together.

sections.label: The functional medicine difference

headings.text: We will not call it aging and leave you there.

paragraphs: Here is where we part ways with conventional care. When hormone symptoms appear, the reflex answer is a single prescription or the reassurance that this is simply age. One hormone gets adjusted while the system around it is ignored. That can soften a symptom for a while. But treating one hormone in isolation often pushes another out of balance, and the underlying disruption keeps going.
We would rather do the harder, more honest work. We find what is actually throwing your hormones off and we treat that.
If hormone therapy still has a place in your plan, that should be your informed choice, made with the full picture in front of you, not a default handed to you in a fifteen minute visit.

boldPairs.title: It treats one number, not the system
boldPairs.body: Hormones move together, so adjusting one without the others rarely brings real balance.

boldPairs.title: Normal range is not the same as optimal
boldPairs.body: You can sit inside the lab range and still feel nothing like yourself.

boldPairs.title: It postpones the real balance
boldPairs.body: Calling it age stops the search before anyone asks why your hormones shifted.

headings.text: Hormones move in a loop. We map the whole circle.

paragraphs: Each driver pushes the next. That is why treating one in isolation rarely holds, and why mapping the full cycle changes everything.
